# function: account_account_in_organization

Builds the ARN of an `account` `accountInOrganization`:

```
arn:${Partition}:account::${ManagementAccountId}:account/o-${OrganizationId}/${MemberAccountId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
account_account_in_organization(management_account_id string, organization_id string, member_account_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `management_account_id` (String) Value for `${ManagementAccountId}` in the ARN template.
1. `organization_id` (String) Value for `${OrganizationId}` in the ARN template.
1. `member_account_id` (String) Value for `${MemberAccountId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
